body: Worker fact (Termal::BarA2, from Fable2 #1546, 2026-11-01 13:05Z). In this harness a FOREGROUND Bash call that runs past 600 s is NOT killed: it moves to the background with a 30-minute allowance (Opus3's test-0efd11bc and test-924be236 both finished that way). A call STARTED in background mode with a short timeout IS hard-stopped at that timeout. So for a long focused TEST run whose host credit counts, keep the one-call form in the FOREGROUND, because background-launched focused runs get no credit (bara1-background-focused-run-no-credit). Do not switch to background just to dodge the 10-minute cap. Background with an explicit long timeout is fine only for uncredited work such as a `cargo test --no-run` compile check.
